plan.understanding: Mirror the wrench body across the world ZX plane at Y=0 to create a symmetric lower half with a matching lowered plateau, then place a contained 1 mm-high "TOP" emboss on the existing upper plateau; the dataset top view is trusted because it clearly shows that recessed plateau.

subtasks.goal: On the single body, mirror the complete existing geometry across the world ZX plane identified by planar face #25 at Y=0 (normal [0,-1,0]) and unite the mirrored copy with the original, producing a symmetric body spanning Y=-15..15. The mirrored lower side must include the counterpart of the upper lowered plateau face #1 at Y=14, landing at Y=-14, while the counterpart of outer top face #24 lands at Y=-15. Print the resulting Y extents and the mirrored plateau level, and correct the transform in the same attempt unless they are Y=-15..15 and Y=-14 respectively.

Emboss the exact text "TOP" in Arial on upper lowered plateau face #1 at Y=14, with 10 mm character height and 1 mm positive relief along +Y so its top is flush at Y=15 and does not exceed outer top face #24. Keep the complete text footprint inside the plateau bounded laterally by side faces #4 and #7 and longitudinally by end faces #2 and #8; orient the word along the plateau's long world-Z direction so the 10 mm character height fits across X. Center it approximately at the measured plateau center (X=-0.273, Z=-51.776). Print the achieved text bounding-box center, footprint, and Y range, and correct placement in the same attempt unless its center is approximately (-0.273,-51.776), its footprint remains within X=-7.491..6.945 and Z=-97.4..-6.152, and it spans Y=14..15.
